rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Black dunes rise from the desert landscape around you. No signs of life
are to be seen, and you wonder what made you come here. A huge cave opens
under a sand-covered shelf of rock to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Sand chafes your skin and blinds your eyes as you sink to your ankles
in this black sand that stretches in all directions save north, where a
rock outcropping offers a bit of shade, though is too tall to climb.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The only wind that blows is a harsh desert breeze that does nothing
buy blow the black sand into your eyes and nose.
   The desert continues in all directions save north, where a basalt
outcropping rises high into the desert sky.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Black sand gets in your boots, in your eyes, in your hair. There is 
little in sight that makes the journey here exciting or adventurous, 
except for the rock outcropping that spans the northern horizon and 
breaks up an otherwise boring scene.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The sand blows here so hard you can hardly stand to open your eyes as
you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert.  Even the rocks
that streak from the desert floor to the north offer no protection from
the winds.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The desert wind pelts your skin with sand, but does not cool your
hot skin.  A small overhang of rock stretches overhead as it reaches
out from the outcropping to the north.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Sweat streams down your body as you trudge through the heat-retaining
sands.  Only thoughts of water and shelter from the sun fill your mind.
   A row of basalt monoliths streak from the surface to the north, much
to steep and wind-smoothed to climb.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Protected by the rock outcropping to the north, here you enjoy a
short break from the blistering winds and blowing sands that tear
into you from out in the open desert.
   It seems as though it would be a decent place to camp.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A storm seems to be brewing to the east as dark clouds peek over
the rock monoliths to the north.  In all other directions, you can
see only mile after mile of the same bleak, black sands.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east seems to be moving this way, but it's hard to tell 
since there are no real reference points, save the natural basalt wall of
unclimbable height to the north.  Great billows of sand shoot into the sky,
driven by the strong wind.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Hugging the northern outcropping, you look out to see that a storm
to the east is definitely heading this way.  Pausing, you look around
and ponder if it would be a good idea to head back soon.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is blowing sand so hard you can hardly stand to open your eyes.
You stumble almost blindly forward through the desert, though maintain some
sense well enough to know not to head west, where the black sands and horrid
sandholes would quickly swallow you and end your days with a suffocating and
crushing death.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A large figure appears south of you, then suddenly flickers out of existence.
You are apparently hallucinating already.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The waves of heat rolling off the desert make mirages constantly flicker on
the horizon. The dark sand only heightens the effect.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You are lost in the desert. Black sands shift too rapidly to gain any
sense of place.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The metal in your equipment is almost sandblasted into uselessness.  You
you wonder if anything could survive here - including yourself.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You catch yourself staring oddly off into the horizon and wonder if
you will be to explore here for any amount of time without permanent
effects.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You top a dune slightly higher than the rest and see only more black
desert that spans to the horizon.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You glance up from the mesmerizing desert floor and see a great sandstorm
boiling to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Except for the dark clouds to the east, all directions look the same. 
Sand is everywhere.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east picks up speed and seems to leap toward you. Thoughts
of the being caught in the gale fill you with a sense a dread.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the east the edge of the storm looks like it is alive; boiling like
a vast cauldron of sand.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Thirst overwhelms you as you trod through the sands of the desert that
seems to have no end.  What makes the situation worse however, is that a
few sandholes - eddies of funneling sand - appear to the west and consume
the desert and anything that dares dwell on top of it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A sun-bleached bone glares against the dark ground, proving to you that
you are not the first person to brave this region. Hopefully you will not
meet the same fate as this poor soul.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The sections of your armor warmed by the latent heat of the sand
and the intensity of the burning sun sizzle as droplets of sweat fall
across them.
   Around you, all is quiet.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is so strong you can hardly stand to open your eyes for fear
of getting blinded by the sand that whips around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Looking back, you see your footsteps quickly erased by the desert breezes
that blow continuously yet cool nothing.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is so strong you can hardly stand to open your eyes for fear
of getting blinded by the sand that whips around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Your skin begins to blister by the fierce heat, and it's a struggle to 
continue moving.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A fin crests the desert sand for a brief instant. Now you find yourself
wondering how many types of monsters live beneath the desert surface.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is so strong you can hardly stand to open your eyes for fear
of getting blinded by the sand that whips around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Stopping for a moment to rest, you eye the dark storm brewing to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east blacks out the sky, but in other directions the sun
is too harsh to look up for very long.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The black sand seems to suck all the strength from your steps, making your
journey all the more difficult.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A crystal spring bubbles up before you, spilling onto the black sand.
Rushing forward, you find only another mirage. Crestfallen, you trudge on.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: All that you see turns to brown as the desert sun burns the ground.

rooms.name: The Crest Of A Dune
rooms.desc:
You arrive at the top of a large dune.  Looking out, you see only more
trackless desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Time and distance are meaningless now.  Only your will to live keeps you
moving at all.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A dune large than most rises to the south. Other than that, everything looks
the same.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is so strong you can hardly stand to open your eyes for fear
of getting blinded by the sand that whips around you in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You pitch forward into the sand, collapsing from the heat and effort.
After a moments rest, you drag yourself to your feet and manage to go on.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An enormous sandstorm blots out the eastern horizon. Elsewhere no clouds
float to blot the sky.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: The storm to the east rolls even closer, and the hot desert wind picks up.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The sandstorm eastward is almost on top of you, making you reconsider
traveling in that direction with a calmer desert to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A tall man clad in white appears on the horizon, then vanishes as you
blink, leaving you wondering if it was real or yet another mirage.
   What is most definitely not a mirage is the gaping sandhole to the
west that seems to grow as the desert sands are swallowed by it.
   Realizing what a rapid death that would be, you reconsider your other
options of travel.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stop for a moment, dumping out the handfuls of sand that have collected
in your boots.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Rays of heat seem to melt into your brain. The sun never seems to set.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The black sand that absorbs the desert heat finally burns a blister through
the soles of your boots.  You know that this will be the first of many such
costs of the heat.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the south you think you see some sort of large obelisk.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A large dune breaks the horizon to the south - or is it the north?  The
sun is directly overhead so you cannot easily tell.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Some sort of structure to the south breaks the horizon.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is so strong you can hardly stand to open your eyes for fear
of getting blinded by the sand that whips around you in all directions.

rooms.name: A Charred Strike
rooms.desc:
A spot of darker black mars the ground. It looks like lightning hit here,
turning the sand into a circular sheet of black glass.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Nothing much matters to you anymore except water.  A cloud of blowing
sand marks the edge of a storm to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The darkness of the storm to the east is impenetratable, even by the
desert sun.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An oasis breaks the monotony of the desert to the south as you gaze
upon wild palms that surround what must be a pool of water!
   Reining in your excitement, however is a gaping sandhole that grows
rapidly in size to the west.  Quickly, you rush away from the deadly
region and head for more stable ground.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the southwest a clump of trees grows - it must be an oasis!

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: You have stopped sweating: a sure sign that heat stroke can't be far away.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A structure of some sort rises out of the sand to the southeast. In all 
other directions, you see only the wavy black line of the desert horizon.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark, unmoving shape to the south is dwarfed only slightly by the
dune that blocks your sight to the southeast.  The heat that rises
from the desert sand feels like you are trudging through Hell.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
The dryness of the air flakes your skin and makes you mouth so dry it
seems to crack even the inner walls of your cheeks.  Looking southward,
you see a large dune rise against the horizon.  Elsewhere you see only
dark sand.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark, unmoving shape to the south is dwarfed only slightly by the
dune that blocks your sight to the southwest.  Strong gusts beat on you,
pelting you with stinging sand.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A statuesque monument stands to the southeast. You wonder what it is and
who could have built it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The sand spins furiously into a whirlwind to the east.  Though it
is spinning, it doesn't seem to be moving in any particular direction.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A sandstorm of wreaks havoc to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Sand from east whips at your body, stinging your face and other exposed
body parts.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The oasis you thought you've seen from afar turns out to be just another
mirage, one of many you have seen this day, even in the escaping heat of
night.
   To the west, a few sandholes appears.  Occasionally, a huge worm raises
its head from the orifice, only to plunge back into sand. It appears that
there must be a solid shelf of rock beneath you as the sand, though warm,
is firmly packed, as though it is resting upon something solid.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An oasis springs from the desert floor to the west. Your mouth almost begins
to salivate at the thought of fresh water.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The eastern horizon is interrupted by an unmoving structure. All other
directions lead to more desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A large statue of some sort is to the east.  Judging the distance, you
would guess it is larger than most of the shops in Malikor.

rooms.name: Before the Sphinx
rooms.desc:
Perhaps the only shade for miles is here, beside the base of stone on
which rests an enormous figure. A massive dune towers to the southeast,
and other marble figures can be seen to the south and east.

rooms.name: North of the Enormous Dune
rooms.desc:
South of you is an enormous sand dune, not quite tall enough to shelter
you from the heat of the sun that bakes your skin.  East and west of you
stand huge marble sphinxes. 
   Oddly, they seem to be watching you.

rooms.name: Before the Sphinx
rooms.desc:
Perhaps the only shade for miles is here, beside the base of stone on
which rests an enormous figure. A massive dune towers to the southwest,
and other marble figures can be seen to the south and west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west a marble figure stands guardian over the desert. Nothing else
can be seen for miles.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A large storm brews to the east, but perhaps you can find shelter in the
lee of a large mound of rocks to the southeast.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You think you see an opening in a rough outcrop of rock that juts out of the 
ground to the southeast.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You think you see an opening in a rough outcrop of rock that juts out of the 
ground to the south.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
There seems to be an oasis to the north! Finally you can dip into some
refreshing water after many days in the desert.
   There also seems to be another anomaly to the west, as geysers of sand
spew up from the desert floor to create earthen rains and sinkholes in that
direction.  You quickly assess the footing and decide against traveling to
the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the northwest, you can see green foliage - there must be water!
In all other directions, however, sun-blistered sands blanket the hot
terrain, making the oasis seem that much more inviting.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A massive dune, black as night, rises to the east. Waves of heated air
escape the surface and distort your vision of the surrounding desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You notice that the large dune to the east is flanked on the north and
south by large statues, as though the tall marble figures stood as sentinels
to guard the sandy mound.

rooms.name: West of the Enormous Dune
rooms.desc:
East of you is an enormous sand dune that is easily tall enough to 
protect against daylight sun and nighttime winds.  North and south of
you stand huge marble sphinxes.
   Oddly, they seem to be watching you.

rooms.name: On Top of a Sand Dune
rooms.desc:
You sink ankle-deep into the top of the dune, peering around at the
bleak desert before you.  Mountains loom far to the north and west, and
the black desert spreads out as far you can see to the south.
   Just below you, you notice a patch of odd colored sand.

rooms.name: East Of the Enormous Dune
rooms.desc:
West of you is an enormous sand dune that is easily tall enough to 
protect against daylight sun and nighttime winds.  North and south of
you stand huge marble sphinxes.
   Oddly, they seem to be watching you.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The large dune to the west is flanked on the north and south by large 
statues.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west a large dune rises above the others. Eastward a dark storm
clouds the horizon, but a large jut of rock stands between you and the
coming storm.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You think you see an opening in a rough outcrop of rock that juts out
of the ground to the east.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Before you opens the mouth of a large cave, leading eastward into the
earth.  The darkness looks inviting after so long in the hot sands and
open desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The winds blow so hard you can hardly stand to open your eyes, and you
stumble almost blindly forward through the desert.  You are aware enough
however to walk away from the rumbling and the blasting sand geysers that
dot the terrain to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You catch a glimpse of movement in the sand beneath your feet. A large,
hairy tarantula senses your movements and quickly burrows itself, making
you wonder how many other creatures live beneath the desert floor.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the northeast a dune slightly larger than the ones around it stands
between two enormous statues.  The statues appear to be sand-blasted and
well-worn, but still appear to be formidable and able to defy the daytime
sun.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Directly east of you, a gigantic marble sphinx sits watching the desert.
Northeast of you is a massive dune of black sand, just one of many that
rise in the desert.

rooms.name: Before the Sphinx
rooms.desc:
Perhaps the only shade for miles is here, beside the base of stone on
which rests an enormous figure.  A massive dune towers to the northeast,
and other marble figures can be seen to the north and east.

rooms.name: South of the Enormous Dune
rooms.desc:
North of you is an enormous sand dune, almost tall enough to block
out the nighttime winds and blot out the daytime sun.  East and west 
of here stand two enormous marble sphinxes.

rooms.name: Before the Sphinx
rooms.desc:
Perhaps what would be the only shade from the daytime sun for miles
lies here.  Beside the base of stone that rises well above you, a dark
statue rises into the desert sky.
   A massive dune towers to the northwest, while other marble figures
can be seen to the north and west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
West of here, a stone sphinx rests on a marble base, stories tall.
Just northwest of it, a black sand dune touches the sky.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the northwest, a dune slightly larger than the ones around it stands
between two enormous statues.
   The desert extends in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You think you see an opening in a rough outcrop of rock that juts out
of the ground to the northeast.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You think you see an opening in a rough outcrop of rock that juts out
of the ground to the north.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Through the desert, you catch a glipse of green foliage to the southeast at   the bottom of the ravine.  A small, tight pathway to the west seems to wind     itself towards the edge of the ravine.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Palms and shrubbery form a tight ring around a small pool of water to the
south.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the southwest a small ring of green growth marks a desert oasis.
Blistering heat trapped in the desert sands as well as from the hot
air make stopping by the oasis a necessity.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A massive statue on a marble base towers above you to the northeast.
Only slightly larger is the black dune of sand which rests behind the
statue.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark unmoving shape to the north is dwarfed only slightly by the
dune that blocks your sight to the northeast.  The wind-tossed sands
beat into you like fiery hailstones.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
Your mouth is so dry it seems to crumble. Looking northward you see a
rather large dune rise against the horizon.  Elsewhere you see only sand.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark unmoving shape to the north is dwarfed only slightly by the
dune to the northwest.  Blowing sands beat down on you like a searing
rain.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A large dune rises behind the unmoving statue to the northwest. Everywhere 
else the desert sucks the life out of its residents.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The winds blows sand into your face so hard, you can barely stand to open
your eyes as you stumble blindly through the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark cloud blocks out the desert sky to the east. To the northeast
a large jumble of rocks sticks out of the desert floor.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east picks up speed and covers the ground rapidly,
bearing down on you as you gaze upon it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The desert oasis to the east is a welcome sight after so many days in the
heat. Hopefully the the water there is drinkable.

rooms.name: The Oasis
rooms.desc:
A well of water springs forth from deep within the desert here.  A
few ragged palms and shrubs huddle near to the life-giving pool, but the
harsh sun keeps anything from flourishing beyond the tight ring of green
growth.  Tracks of many undefinable animals can be seen near the edge of
the water.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The desert oasis to the west is a welcome sight after so many days in the
heat.  Hopefully the water there is drinkable.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Looking down, you see horse tracks, ending in a great disarray of sand.
Some great struggle took place here; carrying the horse into the air, or
perhaps under the sand.
   The desert continues all around you.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Fatigue which seemingly vanished during the last rest period comes back,
stronger than ever.  You have to fight to stay on your feet.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A cobblestone roadway lies to the southeast, almost buried under the
ever-growing desert.  It appears older than the sand itself.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A cobblestone roadway is to the south, almost buried under the 
desert.  You can't imagine why it is here, or who built it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A cobblestone roadway is to the south, almost buried under the desert
sands that stretch in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A cobblestone roadway is to your southwest, almost buried under the
ever-shifting desert sands that reach to the horizon.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark storm blackens the eastern sky and stirs up the sands beneath
it, providing a sharp contrast with the calm, dead desert in the other
directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east picks up speed and covers the ground rapidly, bearing
down on you.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You blink your eyes, hoping that the trees to the northeast are not
yet another mirage.
   What is certainly not a mirage is the gaping sandhole to the west
that seems to devour the desert as it meanders throughout the sea of
silt.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You catch a glint of water between the palms that form a small oasis to the
north.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the northwest a small oasis is the only sign of vegetation in miles of
black sand.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Stopping once again, you empty your boots of sand.  Around you, all is
silent.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The winds blow sand so hard, you can hardly stand to open your eyes
as you plow blindly through the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Here, you look out over the desert to see a cobblestone road split the
tall dunes to the east.

rooms.name: The Cobblestone Road
rooms.desc:
This small road of cobblestones seems to be the last vestiges of some
civilization.  All around are tall dunes that flank the road that extends
east and south.

rooms.name: End of the Cobblestone Road
rooms.desc:
The cobblestone road ends here, engulfed by the desert sand.  You figure
that another storm will completely destroy any traces of civilization that
remain.
   The road continues to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A cobblestone road ends to the west.  In all other directions, you see
only the familiar black desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A steady stream of sweat travels down your back. If you don't find water
again soon, you'll dehydrate.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The storm to the east picks up speed and covers the ground rapidly, bearing
down on you.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The land to the south is marked with dark scars and small craters.
   Similarly, active craters mar the terrain to the west as deadly sandholes
swallow and spit sand into the sky.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The land to the south is marked with patches of darker black on the desert
floor.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The desert is cratered with holes and black marks to the south. There is no 
sign of what could have caused the destruction.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The land to the southeast is marked with patches of darker black on the
desert floor.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the southeast is the end of an abandoned cobblestone road. Around it
tall dunes have formed.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An ancient cobblestone road bends from the southeast and ends to the south.
All around you are tall dunes.

rooms.name: The Cobblestone Road
rooms.desc:
This ancient road is worn almost smooth by the desert winds and sand.
It turns eastward to the north and westward to the south.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Standing atop a tall dune, you see an ancient road curve to the west and
end to the north.  No other signs of civilization are visible.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: An ancient cobblestone road ends to the northwest.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: The sky overhead is blotted out by a dark storm to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark storm to the east makes a horrendous howling noise as it moves
closer.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat.
   Off to the west, a sandhole has opened up, swallowing the terrain and
spewing it in semi-liquid geysers.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west the ground is dotted with strange circles blacker than the
earth around them.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An ancient cobblestone road ends to the east; it appears much older than the 
desert itself.

rooms.name: End of the Cobblestone Road
rooms.desc:
The road made of small cobblestones ends here, covered by the desert sand.
You figure that another storm will completely destroy any traces of ancient
civilizations that may have been here.  
   The road continues to the east.

rooms.name: The Cobblestone Road
rooms.desc:
This small road of cobblestones seems to be the last vestiges of some
civilization.   All around, tall dunes cast shadows on the road the winds
west and north.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: An ancient cobblestone road curves northward to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind blows the sands so hard, you can hardly stand to open your eyes
as you stumble blindly forward through the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the east a great storm hurls sand high into the air.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: The storm to the east only barely blots out the desert sun.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something has
melted the black sand with a great heat.
   Deadly sandholes blot the terrain to the west, making passage impossible.

rooms.name: The Hole in the Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
Judging from the size of the hole below you, a creature of considerable size
must dwell underneath your very feet.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something has
melted the black sand with a great heat.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Jet-black circles dot the ground to the west.  Elsewhere is only desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An ancient cobblestone road appears from between some dunes to the
northeast.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An ancient road ends to the north and runs eastward.  High dunes surround
it on all sides.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A cobblestone road curves west and runs away from you just north of here.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: An ancient cobblestone road takes a bend to the northwest.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An obsidian-like circle of glass has formed on the desert floor here,
perhaps due to a strike of lightning.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the east a great storm rises above the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The edge of the storm is just east of here, forming a barrier between
total darkness and relative light.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat and formed an unnatural solid
wall of hardened silica to the south and west.
   From behind the wave-shaped walls, you can hear the rumblings and wild
churnings of sand being crunched and tossed into the air.

rooms.name: The Blasted Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat and formed an unnatural solid
wall of hardened silica to the south.
   From behind the wave-shaped wall, you can hear the rumblings and wild
churning of sand being crunched and tossed into the air.

rooms.desc:
The ground is pock-marked with obsidian-like natural glass.  Something
has melted the black sand with a great heat and formed an unnatural solid
wall of hardened silica to the south.
   From behind the wave-shaped wall, you can hear the rumblings and wild
churning of sand being crunched and tossed into the air.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Jet-black circles dot the ground to the west.  Elsewhere is only desert.
   A series of blasts are heard coming from the south where deadly geysers
of sand spew into the air.  Even from here, you can feel the sting of the 
falling sand.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The winds blow sand into your eyes, making it impossible to keep the open.
Cursing, you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert, careful to
avoid the source of the blasting sands to the south.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The winds blow sand into your eyes, making it impossible to keep the open.
Cursing, you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert, careful to
avoid the source of the blasting sands to the south.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Waves of heat wash over you, bringing on a torrent of sweat that seems to
steam in the dry air as the sandholes blow stinging grains into you from the
south.
   Quickly, you turn your back to the southern sand-geysers and move on.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Closing your eyes does little to block out the unforgiving winds and sands.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Waves of heat wash over you, bringing on a torrent of sweat that seems to
steam in the dry air as the sandholes blow stinging grains into you from the
south.
   Quickly, you turn your back to the southern sand-geysers and move on.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A dark cloud brews on the eastern horizon, making the deadly sandholes
to the south petty in comparison no matter how deadly they may be.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The sandstorm to the east shrieks fiendishly as it churns across the
desert, roaring above the noise of the deadly sandholes to the south.

rooms.name: Inside the Tomb
rooms.desc:
Sand filters in from above, threatening to fill the shaft.  The smell of
decay makes your stomach churn, and light from the opening above you seems
to dissolve as it reaches the ground.  You think you hear something stirring
in the enormous cavern to the south.

rooms.name: Inside the Tomb
rooms.desc:
Even with a light source, the darkness here is barely pierced.  The stench
of death is overwhelming.  You hear something rustle in the darkness to the
south, and you catch yourself glancing longingly at the entrance shaft to the
north.

rooms.name: In the Tomb
rooms.desc:
Walls surround you north and east, and a pillar of granite blocks your way
to the south.  Something seems to be moving on the other side of the pillar,
but you cannot be sure if its not just your imagination.

rooms.name: Between Two Pillars
rooms.desc:
The light from the entrance to the north is barely a flicker, and
the darkness to the south complete.  You get a strong feeling that you
are being watched from behind the pillars on either side of you.

rooms.name: Behind the Drape
rooms.desc:
The decapitated corpses of the dead are strewn haphazardly about the room,
and a wall of gleaming skulls seems to peer intently at you.  You sense an
old, powerful presence here and feel certain that it has sensed you.
   The only exit is to the east.

rooms.name: Inside the Tomb
rooms.desc:
A gold drape to your west covers a doorway, and crumbles at your touch.  You
can barely squeeze between two pillars to the east, and the tomb seems to open
up to the south.

rooms.name: Behind the Pillar
rooms.desc:
In the corner lays an emaciated body, obviously at least part of the source
of the tremendous odor in the tomb.  Judging from the smell and new, bloated
appearance, the corpse couldn't be more than a few days old.  The cause of
death seems to have been starvation.  But what could have made a man choose
certain excruciating death by starvation over the chance of survival in the
open desert?

rooms.name: In the Tomb
rooms.desc:
You wonder if you haven't gotten disoriented in the vast darkness.  The
southern wall of the tomb suddenly appears before you, and a pillar blocks
your way west.  To the east darkness reigns supreme.

rooms.name: Before the Heathen Altar
rooms.desc:
A black altar inscribed with pagan runes drips fresh blood steadily onto
the rough-hewn floor.  Waves of evil emanate from behind the altar to the
south.

rooms.name: Behind the Heathen Altar
rooms.desc:
Blood and gore cover the walls in this den of putrid evil.  You wonder to
yourself what has led you to proceed into this mausoleum, and the dark shape
that seems to rise endlessly from the floor makes you wonder if this will be
your final resting place.

rooms.name: The Nest
rooms.desc:
This room housed some sort of nest for the creature above.  Mangled bones,
weapons, armor, and treasure are intermingled in a horrible matte of nauseating
excrement.

rooms.name: In The Tomb
rooms.desc:
Walls surround you north and west, and a pillar of granite blocks your
way to the south.  Something seems to be moving on the other side of the
pillar, but you cannot be sure if its not just your imagination.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A terrible storm to the west cuts off any passage that direction, unless
you are willing to try to enter it.
   To the north, a geyser of sand spews tons of fine grains into the air,
falling as a stinging rain the pelts you and draws blood from your exposed
flesh.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is blowing sand at you so hard, you can hardly stand to open your
eyes, and you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert.
   To the north, a deadly sand-geyser spews from behind a small monolith of
basalt.  The monolith appears to buffer you against the full force of the 
geyser behind it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is blowing sand at you so hard, you can hardly stand to open your
eyes, and you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert.
   To the north, a deadly sand-geyser spews from behind a small monolith of
basalt.  The monolith appears to buffer you against the full force of the 
geyser behind it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stumble in the thick black sand, and have to use all your willpower to
stand again.  The urge to succumb to the heat radiating upward from the sand
is overwhelming.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the east, the desert gives birth to a dusty road.  It looks rarely
used, though is a sign that some civilization once dwelled here.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road Through The Desert
rooms.desc:
This worn trail can barely be called a road.  It has seen little use and
threatens to be turned back into desert.
   To the north, a basalt monolith blocks passage in that direction.  You 
can hear sounds of spewing sand behind it and are thankful for the defense.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west is a dusty road through the desert. The black sand is fire-hot 
under your boots, even though the impassable basalt outcropping to the north
shield the sands from the daytime heat.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind is blowing sand at you so hard, you can hardly stand to open your
eyes, and you stumble almost blindly forward through the desert.
   To the north, a deadly sand-geyser spews from behind a small monolith of
basalt.  The monolith appears to buffer you against the full force of the 
geyser behind it.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The heat of the desert sand stifles all thoughts of adventuring or aimless
exploring.  You hug the basalt outcropping to the north, feeling its lukewarm
surface cool you slightly against the heat.
   There appears to be something to the south, but knowing the heat, it is
almost certainly a mirage.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The heat of the desert sand stifles all thoughts of adventuring or aimless
exploring.  You hug the basalt outcropping to the north, feeling its lukewarm
surface cool you slightly against the heat.

rooms.name: In The Desert
rooms.desc:
Silent sands surround you to the south and west, sweeping outward away
from the tall outcroppings to the north and east that seem to form some
sort of ancient, volcanic barrier that borders the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
An awesome storm rages to the west.  In all other directions the sky 
remains clear except for the occasional blast of desert sand.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The ground around you is pitch black like a cinder.  The black sands 
extend lifelessly in all directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Your feet begin to blister under the latent heat of the sands.  There
seems to be no escape from the heat.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: Wiping off the sweat from your brow for the hundredth time, you trudge on.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A dusty road cuts through the desert to the east.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road Through The Desert
rooms.desc:
This worn trail can barely be called a road.  It has seen little use and
threatens to be turned back into desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A dusty road cuts through the desert to the west.

rooms.name: In The Desert
rooms.desc:
A pile of bleached bones stares up at you from the black sand. You try not
to think that it could be you one day very soon.
   A cluster of trees that has to be a mirage appears to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
It is extremely hot and you are in need of a good drink of water.  The
black desert stretches endlessly around you.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You see only the gently rolling sand dunes, stretching out for miles,
except for the tips of some leafy green plants over the dunes to the west.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc: You see only the gently rolling sand dunes, stretching out for miles.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You trudge through the desert, no longer certain of where you are; 
no longer caring.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A dusty trail leads around some sort of encampment to the southeast.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A small dusty trail to the south skirts a quiet village beyond.  In all
other directions, the desert stretches without end.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the south, a small dusty east-west trail leads to a quiet village in
the distance.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the southeast some large gates defend the entrance to a small village.
East of here a dusty road leads north through the desert while to the south,
a worn trail heads around the village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Road Through the Desert
rooms.desc:
This worn trail can barely be called a road.  It has seen little use and
threatens to turn back into desert.  To the south are the gates of a small
village.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the southwest are some large gates leading into a small village.
West of here, a dusty road leads north through the desert, while to
the south, a worn trail heads around the village.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the south a trail has been worn in the sand around a fenced village.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You are standing north of trail leading around a high village fence.  The
desert surrounds you in all directions, save north where you can see a few
trees.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
In the distance to the southwest, a dusty trail bends around the corner
of a quiet village.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind drives the sand into your eyes so hard you can barely open them
to see.  You struggle as you stumble forward through the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The heat of the sand is so intense that you contemplate entering the rising
storm to the west just to feel the cooler, moving air.  The desert stretches
in all other direction.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
Off to the east, you notice a bend in a dusty trail that leads around a
high, spiked wall.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail bends here, heading south and east around a high spiked fence.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads east and west around a high fence to the south.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc:
The trail leads east and west around a high fence to the south.  To the 
east lie the gates of the village that lies behind the fence, defended from
the surrounding desert.

rooms.name: The Gates of the Rakshasa Village
rooms.desc:
To the south you notice a break in the high, spiked fence that surrounds
the village.  A dusty road leads north, away from the town, while a series
of splintering paths lead away from the road to the east and west outside the
wall.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc:
The trail leads east and west around a high fence to the south.  To the
west, you see the gates of the village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads east and west around a high fence to the south.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail bends here, heading south and west around a high, spiked fence.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: To the west is a bend in a dusty trail around a high, spiked fence.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The wind blows the sands so hard into your eyes that you can barely stand
to open them as you stumble through the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A sandstorm to the west threatens to overtake you.  Suddenly, the open
desert looks much more inviting.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: You stand just west of a worn trail around a small village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
This straw and mud hut is where the Rakshasa citizens live.  A bare rug
lies on the floor while a simple table stands in the corner, providing a
resting place for an assortment of bones.
   Looking closer, you are uncertain whether they are the bones of humans or
some animal and wonder if it would be best if you didn't stick around to find
out.
   To the east you see a path and to the south you see another large hut.

rooms.name: A Path Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
Rakshasan citizens travel along this path, ignoring you as they go about
their business.  You notice the blandness of the decorations and the lack of
vegetation of the village, and begin to wonder why they would choose this
area in which to live.
   To the west you see a large hut.  The path leads east through the village.

rooms.name: Inside The Gate
rooms.desc:
You see Rakshasan citizens scurry along the road to their destinations,
seeming to be in a hurry to complete their tasks.
   From here you can make out the details of the village: the wide, dusty
streets, the windowless straw and mud huts, the dry, cracked village walls,
and the general lack of vegetation in the area.
   The road leads east, south, and west through the village and out to the
desert to the north.

rooms.name: A Path Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
There are many Rakshasa citizens traveling along this path.  You notice the
blandness of the decorations and the lack of vegetation and begin to wonder
what compels these residents to stay.
   To the east you see a large hut.  The path leads west through the village.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
This straw and mud hut is where the Rakshasa citizens live.  A bare rug
lies on the floor while a simple table stands in the corner, providing a
resting place for an assortment of bones.
   Looking closer, you are uncertain whether they are the bones of humans or
some animal and wonder if it would be best if you didn't stick around to find
out.
   To the west you see a path and to the south you see another large hut.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stand just east of a worn trail.  The hot sands radiate heat in all
other directions.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: You stumble blindly through the blowing sands of the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
A storm brews to the west, gathering speed as it seemingly rises from
nowhere.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A trail to the east leads around a small village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
You see a bare, desolate living quarters.  There are few items in this hut,
but you are able to make out the weapons' rack on the wall and the training
dummy in the corner.  This cannot be the hut of a lowly Rakshasa citizen; it
obviously belongs to someone of stature and power.
   To the north you see another straw hut.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
Upon entrance, you notice a Rakshasan stirring a pot of boiling water with
bones sticking out of the top.  The only other decoration in the room is a
framed picture of the Brown Dragon, the God of the Rakshasa village.
   The exit is to the east.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village.  There is a lot of
hustling and bustling as the Rakshasa citizens go about on their methods of
plotting to kill strangers.
   The street continues north and south through the village.  To the east
and west, dark straw buildings line the street.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
Upon entrance, you notice a Rakshasan stirring a pot of boiling water with
bones sticking out of the top.  The only other decoration in the room is a
framed picture of the Brown Dragon, the God of the Rakshasa village.
   The exit is to the west.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
You see a bare, desolate living quarters.  There are few items in this hut,
but you are able to make out the weapons' rack on the wall and the training
dummy in the corner.  This cannot be the hut of a lowly Rakshasa citizen; it
obviously belongs to someone of stature and power.
   To the north you see another straw hut.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west a trail around a small village looks as if it gets little
use.  In all other directions, desert stretches to the horizon.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
All horizons look the same in this bleak, black desert.  The heat rising
off the sands is almost unbearable.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
Your bloodshot eyes marvel at the cloud formations shifting through
the storm to the west.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc: You are west of a dusty trail surrounding a quiet village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: A Dark Weapons Shop
rooms.desc:
Candles on the wall illuminate the room just enough for you to see all the
full weapons' racks on the walls.  Apparently the Rakshasa aren't a peaceful
bunch.  You cannot seem to find the keeper of all these weapons, so you are
wary, careful not to turn your back for too long to the dark corner of the
room.  He may be hiding there.  A large sign hangs on the wall.  There is
a door to the east.

rooms.name: Entrance To The Weapons Shop
rooms.desc:
It's so dark here that you can barely see your own hand before your eyes.
Better watch out; the Rakshasa are great at pouncing from dark corners.  To
the west lies a door to the shop and to the east the main street extends into
the village.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village.  There is a lot of
activity here as the Rakshasa citizens go about on their business.
   The street continues north and south through the village, flanked on the
east and west by large, dark buildings.  You can hear sounds coming from
inside them.

rooms.name: The Entrance to a Dark Magic Shop
rooms.desc:
This unlit shop smells strongly of herbs and decaying flesh.  The shadows
are thick and you become aware of a Rakshasan watching you from the corner as
you examine the wares around you.
   To the east is a door and to the west is the main street.

rooms.name: A Dark Magic Shop
rooms.desc:
Candles on the wall illuminate the room just enough for you to notice all
the strange concoctions on the shelves.  You look around the chamber for the
mad wizard who created all this, but he is nowhere to be found.  You see a
sign on the wall.
   There is a door to the west.

rooms.name: The Heavenly Meadows
rooms.desc:
You are on soft, pink clouds, somewhere high up in the skies. Far above and
a little to the left, you see a raspberry moon, pinned to the firmament, maybe
by some drunken God with a peculiar sense of humor. You notice that there is
no cream on the raspberry. This place fills you with pinkish happiness and you
suddenly get the urge to eat those little pills your Mother warned you about!

rooms.name: On The Raspberry Moon
rooms.desc:
You are on a HUUUGE raspberry, which has a somewhat moon-like appearance.
It hangs by a particularly thin thread from the nearby firmament.  You get a
feeling of overwhelming sadness as you notice the complete absence of light,
fluffy cream.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc: A massive tower juts out of the ground to the east.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A small dune rises to the west at the edge of a gigantic sandstorm.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
The trail to the east surrounds a high spiked fence.  All other directions
lead back into the desert.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: A Side Road
rooms.desc:
This road leads east through the Rakshasa Village and is blocked by a high,
spiked fence to the west.  There is less traffic on this road than the main
street. 
   To the south you see a very large, evil-looking building.

rooms.name: A Side Road
rooms.desc:
This road leads east and west through the Rakshasa Village.  There is less
traffic on this road than the main street.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village.  There is a lot of
activity here as the Rakshasa citizens go about their daily business.
   The street continues north and south through the village.  You see a side
road leading east and west from here as well.  At the point in which the two
roads cross, you see a large, deep well.

rooms.name: A Side Road
rooms.desc:
This road leads east and west through the Rakshasa Village.  There is less
traffic on this road than the main street.

rooms.name: A Side Road
rooms.desc:
This road leads west through the Rakshasa Village and is blocked by a high,
spiked fence to the east.  There is less traffic on this road than the main
street. 
   To the south you see a large well-maintained building.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
To the west a trail around a small village looks as if it gets little use.
All other directions lead off into the desert.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
There's so much sand in your eyes you wish you were blind and the heat
rising from the desert dunes almost makes your wish come true as your tears
mix with the grains and tear at your eyes.
   All the horizons look the same.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: A shrill howling rises from the storm raging to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc: You stand west of worn trail around a walled village.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: An Entrance to the Temple
rooms.desc:
his room leads to the Temple of the Rakshasa Village.  The candles on the
walls light your way through the building.  The room continues east and south
of here.

rooms.name: North Of The Altar
rooms.desc:
You are standing in a small niche just north of a strangely-shaped altar.
The air is dry here and is full of static energy.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village.  There is a lot of
activity here as the Rakshasa citizens go about their lives.
   The street continues north and south through the village.

rooms.name: Inside The Nursery
rooms.desc:
Here, Rakshasa cubs wrestle each other playfully.  The walls are
decorated with pictures of the Brown Dragon, as well as pictures of
humans, elves, and dwarves to teach the cubs what to hunt.

rooms.name: Entrance To The Nursery
rooms.desc:
You hear the sounds of the Rakshasa cubs playfully growling in the
background.  The walls are decorated with figures of the Brown Dragon,
to instill fear into the cubs at an early age, no doubt.  The floor is
littered with toys and torn objects.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stand just east of a worn trail.  The desert heat rises from the dunes
in all other directions.

rooms.name: In the Desert
rooms.desc:
There is so much sand in your eyes you fear permanent damage from the
constant abrasions.  The wind blows hard and you struggle to find shelter.
   To the east lies a sand-covered mine entrance while the desert stretches
outward in all other directions.

rooms.name: In the Dry Dusty Desert
rooms.desc:
The sand is not as fine here as it was farther north, and cacti grow more
abundant.  You look around for shelter from the storm to the west, but find
none in sight.

rooms.name: The Dry Dusty Desert
rooms.desc: A worn trail to the east leads around a high spiked wall.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the east.

rooms.name: West of the Altar
rooms.desc:
You are standing in the shadows of an Altar room.  The altar itself
stands in the open to the east, inviting you to explore its polished
surface and intricate designs.

rooms.name: The Temple Altar
rooms.desc:
In the center of the room, you see a black marble altar shaped like a huge
tiger claw.  There are bloodstains all around the room, not just on the altar.
There have obviously been many sacrifices to the Brown Dragon in this room.
You can almost hear the screams of those who have been tortured here.
   To the north and west you can see the chamber lead away from the altar.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village. There is a lot of
activity here as the Rakshasa citizens go about on their daily lives.
   The street continues north and south through the village.

rooms.name: Inside the Nursery
rooms.desc:
You see the Rakshasa cubs wrestling each other playfully.  The walls are
decorated with more pictures of the Brown Dragon, as well as those of humans,
elves, and dwarves, obviously intended as instruction on what to fear and
what to hunt.

rooms.name: Inside the Nursery
rooms.desc:

decorated with more pictures of the Brown Dragon, as well as those of humans,
elves, and dwarves, obviously intended as instruction on what to fear and
what to hunt.

use.  All other directions lead off into the desert that threatens to 
devour the faint trail.

rooms.desc:
Through shimmering waves of rising heat, you think you see a large structure
to the west.  Everything you wear is almost too hot to touch now, and sweat
streams down your body in rivulets.

rooms.name: The Dry Dusty Desert
rooms.desc:

of the shrieking storm to the west.

rooms.name: The Dry Dusty Desert

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail

rooms.name: Base of the Tower
rooms.desc:
You are standing at the base of an enormous tower.  There is a small square
door in the ceiling, guarded by several large felines.  Someone or something
of importance must lie in the room above.
   The tower exits to the east.

rooms.name: Path Along The Wall
rooms.desc:
Many Rakshasan citizens travel along this path.  You notice the blandness
of the decorations and the lack of vegetation of the village which seems to
reflect the Rakshasan mentality of simplicity.
   To the west lies a large tower, at the end of the east-west road that
splits the village.

rooms.name: The Feline Way
rooms.desc:
You are traveling on the main street of the village.  There is a lot of
activity here as the Rakshasa citizens go about on their daily business.
   The street continues north through the village and south, where you see
a gate exiting into the desert.  A path extends to the east and west from
here as well.

rooms.name: A Path Along the Wall
rooms.desc:
Rakshasan citizens travel along this path, ignoring the blandness of the
decorations and the lack of vegetation of the village, and directing their
attentions to other business.
   To the east, at the end of this east-west road, a large hut stands open.

rooms.name: A Straw Hut
rooms.desc:
This is where the Rakshasan citizens live.  The hut is made of a straw and
mud mixture and displays only a rug on the floor and a table in the corner.
On the table are some bones, though it is hard to make out whether they are
the bones of humans or some animal.
   To the west an exit leads to the street.

You stand in a deep barrow that runs along the canyon to the southwest.
Proceeding that direction would certainly shorten your life - better to

rooms.name: A Step Into The Canyon
rooms.desc:
You seem to be caught in some sort of cross wind as you make your plunge
into the canyon. Suddenly, you realize that not even a magical ward of flying
would be sufficient to stop the winds from dashing you into the hard, sharp
surface of the canyon walls that pierce and batter you.
   Mercifully, you begin to lose consciousness before you reach the thrusting
spire below you and you take consolation in the fact that your death is not
a slow one.

rooms.name: A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The passageway seems to open straight back into the mountain.  The light
from the entranceway to the west glints eerily off your weapon.

rooms.name: A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The passageway seems to open eastward back into the mountain, stretching
west back into the desert.

rooms.name: A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel is cool, almost cold after the hot desert.  The black walls are
dry to the touch, but the humidity is rising as you go deeper into the ground.
   The passage continues to the east and west.

rooms.name: A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You trail your fingers along the wall, stepping over fallen stones and rock
formations.  The ceiling above you seems to be solid enough for you to be
comfortable that it will not cave in on you.

rooms.name: End Of A Long Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The passageway apparently stops abruptly to the east, but its really too
dark to be certain.  The cool darkness of the tunnel is refreshing after so 
long in the desert.

rooms.name: The Top Of A Hole
rooms.desc:
You stand precariously at the edge of a hole slightly larger than your
shoulders.  You could probably drop yourself down safely, but it would be 
a rough landing and you would have to be skilled at climbing to get back
up.  The stone walls are actually glistening with moisture now - the first 
signs of water you've seen outside the desert.

rooms.name: A Short Drop To The Ground
rooms.desc:
A narrow tunnel leads off to the east, and you may be able to scale the
ledge upwards if you're agile enough.  The rock walls are slick and muddy.

rooms.name: A Bend In The Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel reaches a junction to the south, and seems to abruptly end to
the east.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
The tunnel comes to a sudden halt behind the dried up form of a mummified
elf.  The corpse looks as though it would disintegrate if disturbed. Above the
head of the figure is some writing carved into the stone.

rooms.name: A Dead End
rooms.desc:
The tunnel narrows to a stop in a small cavern.  Something stirs from the 
walls all around you as you pass by.

rooms.name: A Shiny Cavern
rooms.desc:
This cavern gleams brightly from pyrite deposits in the walls.  A pit in the
floor leads down, and a narrow tunnel begins to the east.

rooms.name: A Junction
rooms.desc: The tunnel splits northward here from the east-west tunnel.

rooms.name: A Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel narrows to the west, and continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Narrow Tunnel
rooms.desc: The tunnel narrows to the west, and continues to the east.

rooms.name: A Junction
rooms.desc:
To the east the tunnel seems to enter a cavern, and a landslide has created
a large hole in the floor.  To the west the tunnel narrows.

rooms.name: The Second Cavern
rooms.desc:
Your boots crunch on something as you enter the cavern, and you look down
to see the bones and trappings of some poor desert nomad.  Shining your light
around, you can't see the floor due to the myriad other shiny skeletons that
litter the floor.  In the shadows, you sense that the cause of all the death
looms before you.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Stalactites brush you as you pass, and your boots are covered in black mud.
The tunnel continues east and opens into a large cavern downward.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel branches to the north here.  The footing is dangerous, and holes
in the floor reveal tremendous drops if you should slip.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
A large hole in the ceiling reveals another giant room above you.  The t
tunnel stretches on east and west.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
A cool breeze wafts by you, drying the tunnel walls the lead east and
west.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You almost stumble into a dark pit in the floor, from which cold air blows
steadily.  The tunnel continues east and west.

rooms.name: A Rocky Tunnel
rooms.desc:
A cool breeze wafts by you, but the tunnel walls are becoming drier. The
tunnel leads east and west.

rooms.name: A Landslide
rooms.desc:
A landslide has closed the tunnel to the east, but opened a passable hole
in the ceiling. You nervously eye the roof inches above your head for signs
of crumbling, but it seems to be solid rock.

rooms.name: Inside the Caves
rooms.desc:
Harsh sunlight streams weakly in from the east, not quite illuminating the
gnarled sandy wall. A pit in the midst of the floor leads down into the
mountains.

rooms.name: In the First Cavern
rooms.desc:
Your light doesn't reach the top of this enormous cavern, and the silence is
overwhelming. A rocky tunnel leads upwards, and hole in the floor goes deeper
into the earth.

rooms.name: The End of the Shaft
rooms.desc:
The shaft opens up into this large room, dusty and obviously made by the same
creature that created the shaft. The sand on the floor reveals the room has
been recently occupied.

rooms.name: In the Shaft
rooms.desc:
The walls are unwaveringly level, but rough and marked, possibly by some
sort of claw. A room opens up to the west, and you strain your ear to
hear signs of life.

rooms.name: In the Shaft

rooms.name: Entrance to the Shaft
rooms.desc:
A horizontal shaft has been bored straight through the wall by something
tremendously strong. Small holes in the thin floor seem to be the source
of the continual breeze.

rooms.name: Behind the Waterfall
rooms.desc:
A waterfall streams down before you, bringing a damp mist, but to the east a
hot sandy wind blows.. the desert must be in that direction. You stand on a
small ledge behind the waterfall; below you the torrent of water turns into a
river heading deeper into the mountains.

rooms.name: A Sandy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Hot sandy air blows in from the east, but the sound of rushing water from the
west seems strangely out of place in the desert heat.

rooms.name: A Sandy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You can hear the sound of running water to the west, and it calls to you as
you hatefully eye the sand trickling down from the hole in the ceiling just
above your head.

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The black mud is shin deep here, and you trudge through it with effort. A
slick muddy hole opens above you onto a ledge, and the tunnel continues
south.

rooms.name: The Mud Pit
rooms.desc:
You step into the room and start to panic as you sink to your knees, then
to your thighs, then to your waist. You finally feel solid ground stop you
from drowning, but at that point the odor of the place overwhelms you. The
cavern smells worse than the castle sewers.

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The wind whistling softly by your ears suddenly brings a new sound: running
water! You force your companions to move faster as you anticipate the taste
of fresh water for the first time in days.

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel Junction
rooms.desc:
An almost sheer drop to the east ends in a deep pit, but the sound of rushing
water beckons you to the south. The mud is not as deep here, and not as thick.

rooms.name: The Bottom of the Slide
rooms.desc:
Your feet slip out from under you as you try to climb down the treacherous
incline, and a startled scream slips from between your clenched teeth. After
a short rough ride, you stand dazed and battered at the bottom of the slide.
Judging from the bones sticking up out of the mud, you're not the only one
to have been trapped here.

rooms.name: A Bend in the Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The tunnel takes a sharp turn to the east here, and narrows into a crawlspace
barely large enough to fit yourself into. Only the cold mud that seeps into
your armor keeps the rocky walls from tearing at your skin as you force your
way deeper into the cave.

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
Inching yourself along on hands and knees, you begin to feel like heading back
for a more easily accessible way past the mountains.

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel

rooms.name: The Muddy Tunnel
rooms.desc:
The crawlspace enlarges to let you walk, although stooped over, at a faster
pace through the tunnel. A narrow slit in the wall leads north, and the tunnel
continues east.

rooms.name: The Dead End
rooms.desc: The tunnel dead ends here at a mass of tumbled stone mired in the mud.

rooms.name: In the Underground River
rooms.desc:
The shallow river runs rapidly here over smooth stones. You sip a little,
and it tastes fantastic after so many days in the hot sun. You can follow
the river to the east, or head north into a muddy tunnel. A small stream of
water from the ceiling has created a natural well here.

rooms.name: In the Underground River
rooms.desc:
The sound of splashing water echoes from the east. The water seeps into the
links of your armor, making the sand grit even more harshly against your skin.

rooms.name: Before the Waterfall
rooms.desc:
A stream of water jets down from the ceiling many feet above you. Behind the
waterfall you can see a stone ledge.

and as the weight of the wind blown sand pushes down on you, you feel the end
growing near.

The wind picks up speed in the blink of an eye. Black sand whips around you,
tearing at your exposed flesh. To the east the storm rages furiously, while
a short distance west it is calm and peaceful, though still hellishly hot.

causes sand to pour steadily into the opening, threatening to seal off the
entrance at any time. Although the threat of being buried alive scares you, the
darkness looks inviting after so long in the blinding sun and sand.

rooms.name: Outside the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The crest on the doors before you shows this to be the ancient Citadel, used
by the Knights of Solamnia as a meeting place for strategic planning against
the forces of the dark pagan hordes. History says that evil magic besieged the 
Citadel with their magical arts, forcing it open and slaying all within.
When the last tortured scream of the knights died out, they perversed their
spirits with the forces of the entire black coven, and banished the Citadel 
here as a last insult to the brave knights that tried to defend their homeland.

rooms.name: Inside the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The ceiling is cracked and blackened, and the very stone of the walls seems
to be warped from the terrors and magics that were worked here. The desert
lies through the great doors to the west, and an enormous spiral staircase is
northeast of here.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A great stone spiral staircase is north of here, and the exit to the west
leads into the abandoned citadel. The air seems to echo with the spirits of the
dead.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A great stone spiral staircase is east of here, and the exit to the south leads
into the citadel south. The air seems to echo with the spirits of the dead.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The spiral stairway rises above you, fading into darkness before you can see
the roof. An enormous pile of bleached bones has built up in the middle of the
stair's spiral, obviously having been flung down from above. Insects crawl all
about, living off of this macabre spectacle.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. The individual steps
are so large it takes two paces to cross them, and the craftsmanship that
keeps them from crushing under their own weight astounds you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The spiral staircase continues to rise here. You can see sunlight shining into
the level above you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
This corner of the landing houses a remarkable tapestry preserved by the
desert heat. It pictures Knights of Solamnia battering down the ferocious
Jun Horde. The spiral staircase heads down to the north, and upwards west of
here.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The floor seems unstable here, crumbling beneath your feet. Obviously the dark
magics transportation of the Citadel caused considerable strain to the 
structure.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The stairs make a landing here, continuing upwards to the southwest and
heading back down at this point to the ground level.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. The individual steps
are so large it takes two paces to cross them, and the craftsmanship that
keeps them from crushing under their own weight astounds you.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The wall to the west has a gaping hole in it, giving a terrific view of the
rolling sand dunes of the desert below. A great sand storm brews on the
horizon, and you hope that it quickly dissipates and does not head this way.
The spiral stair continues to the northeast.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
You see a shadow cast from above cross the stairs to the north. Battle fear
creeps slowly into your system, heightening your senses and quickening your
pulse.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
The stone walls of the Citadel are hot to the touch, obviously being
baked from outside by the blistering sun. The stairs leads up to the east
and down to the south.
   Something shakes the ceiling above you, bringing dust down onto your
head.

rooms.name: In the Abandoned Citadel
rooms.desc:
A loud scuffling on the floor above you is suddenly quiet as you approach
the base of the stairs. Only your party's measured breathing can be heard.

rooms.name: On the Spiral Staircase
rooms.desc:
The stairs spiral upwards to the roof of the Citadel. Sunlight glinting from
below seems to fade into blackness as you concentrate on surviving the monster
above you.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Dragon
rooms.desc:
This corner of the room is obviously the Brass Dragon's sleeping quarters.
The floor is littered with treasures mingled admist fleshless skeletons.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:
Solamnic runes cover the walls, denoting this as the floor belonging to the
most powerful magic-users among the Knights. Scratch marks from dragon's
talons mar the stone floor.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:

rooms.name: The Dragon's Floor
rooms.desc:
A huge Brass Dragon eyes you from across the room. He has evidently set up
residence here in the absence of a suitable cave, and seems angered at your
intrusion into his home.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
Harsh sunlight pours down on your head from above, but does not reach into
the cavern hollowed out of the earth to the south. No sound can be heard
from within.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
The black rock walls reflect no light, and the sand floor absorbs all sound.
The blue dragon seems to come at you from all directions.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Blue Dragon
rooms.desc:
A rustle in the dark makes you curse your eyes, struggling to adjust to the
darkness. Light filters in from the north, but doesn't illuminate anything
but your companions.

rooms.name: The Dragon's Horde
rooms.desc:
This must have been the dragon's treasure room.. sapphires and gold lie all
around.

rooms.name: The Maharajah's Quarters
rooms.desc:
You see an elegantly decorated room with many finely made tapestries of the
Brown Dragon hanging on the walls. Many scantily clad Rakshasi consorts
surround the Maharajah and succumb to his every desire.

rooms.name: A Dusty Trail
rooms.desc: The trail leads north and south around a high fence to the west.

rooms.name: The Desert
rooms.desc:
You stand just east of a worn trail. The sun burns hot on the desert in all
other directions.

rooms.name: The Lair of the Dracolich
rooms.desc: All is dark here....

rooms.name: Outside the Abandoned Lair
rooms.desc: A deep pit opens into the ground before you. Within is total darkness.

rooms.name: In a Strange Cave
rooms.desc:
You stand in a cave seemingly carved from solid rock. Loose desert sand sifts
down  in through the opening above your head. To the south, a dark hole
opens into a gigantic cavern. Tracks beneath your feet can only be those of a
dragon.

rooms.name: In the Dragon's Lair
rooms.desc:
Bones and bits of armor litter the floor here, and the rock walls are scarred 
from the centuries of abrasion against the dragon's diamond-hard scales.
The only exit is to the north.

rooms.name: The Temple of Serapis
rooms.desc:
A bloodstained throne rises before you between black onyx columns. The
vaulted ceiling rises out of sight, but half-rotted corpses dangle down to
eye level on silver hooks. Great tapestries line the walls: a picture of
Pagan and Chalkara fighting a huge lich in Market Square; a picture of a
broken corpse in the baker's stall; and a huge picture of the Goddess Tresia
lounging on a bed surrounded by sleek-furred tigers.

rooms.name: The Well of Souls
rooms.desc:
Serapis' most horrific creatures are sprung into existence here, in the depths
of the brackish pool that fills the center of the room. A ball of light hangs
suspended by magick in the air above the pool, filling the room with a soft
glow that seems to make more shadows than it dispels. The entrance to the west
seems to have disappeared.
